svg.title: FERI / MODULAR MODEL KIT
svg.text: Blender environment reference + editable construction proposal / no meshes or Unity scenes delivered
4 m bays; separate floor, wall, ceiling
Full-level image is not a scale drawing.
Door frame/leaf share one aperture; put leaf
Desk/chair, lectern, board and fluorescent strip
One floor-trap mesh is instanced twice on C; POWER
Boxes for floors, walls, desks and door blockers;
boundaries and test the follow camera.
Trap marker footprint must agree with future
Do not build furniture collision through the
DoorOpenMarker defines a tested leaf position
One shared material palette; no per-door unique
Meters; Unity +Y up. Floor modules originate on finished floor Y = 0.
Separate render geometry, simple collision and semantic markers.
4 m bays and all new dimensions are proposals; test actual player/camera.
Use MODULE_CATALOG.md for all 50 module extents, pivots and collision targets.
Removable ceiling in a cutaway sheet is a presentation aid; camera visibility and collision must be tested in the actual scene.
